title: Restriction on dowry and presents
text: (1) The aggregate value of the dowry and presents given to the bride by her parents, and the bridal gifts given to the bridegroom, shall not exceed the prescribed statutory limit.
source_file: Pakistan Code (pakistancode.gov.pk) / Official Gazette, Dowry and Bridal Gifts (Restriction) Act, 1976
